title: Fix technology sub-pillar weight: it is printed in Juknis Tabel 5, not a residual
description: Citation check cc_issue_001/002/003. Section 3.5 states the technology sub-pillar weight is not printed and recovers it as the residual of the economy pillar at 4.11%. Juknis Tabel 5 p. 94 [pdf 104] prints si_econ_tech | Indeks subpilar teknologi | Rendah (4,1%), per doc_1_juknis-weights_chunk_107 and doc_1_cross-slice-conflict_chunk_001, both non-reconstructed, corroborated by Gambar 11 (E = 1% of composite). Consequences: (1) the six printed economy sub-pillar weights sum to 100.1, not 96.0, so the renormalisation sensitivity giving ~27.2% and ~5.37% and a ~1pp upper bound is void -- renormalising over the real printed set gives 26.12% and 5.15% against 26.15% and 5.15% adopted; (2) the S2 row 'Technology sub-pillar | residual | 100 - 96.0 = 4.11' is arithmetically false (100-96.0=4.0) and 4.11 is another row's value. No headline figure moves; 1.34% holds either way. This REMOVES a caveat from 26.1% and 5.15%.
acceptance_criteria: Section 3.5 cites the printed 4.1%; the renormalisation test reports the economy pillar as null like the others; S2 row corrected to Tabel 5 provenance.

title: Report the sum-to-100 pattern behind the CONTESTED DENOMINATOR caveat
description: Citation check cc_issue_004/005. Section 3.5 says the handbook does not state whether the printed percentages are raw PC1 loadings or normalised contributions -- literally true (doc_1_juknis-weights_chunk_104 says only that weights are produced automatically by PCA). But all fourteen printed weight groups in the corpus sum to 100.0 +/- 0.1: pillars 100.0, economy sub-pillars 100.1, environment 100.0, social 100.0, and all ten variable groups 99.9-100.1. That is the strongest internal evidence available and points to normalised contributions. Report it and narrow the caveat. Separately, the [CONTESTED DENOMINATOR] flag is defined two different ways: 3.5 as the loading/normalisation ambiguity, 3.6 as bears-on versus supplies. Split or reconcile.
acceptance_criteria: Sum-to-100 pattern reported; flag has one definition.
